Assign a personal tune (Pro Plus, this phone)

Mode: FREE. Tap to switch to Pro

Mode: PRO PLUS. Tap to switch to Free
Enjoy your CallTune while you wait for your call to be answered.\n\nHear your own tune on incoming calls and, with outgoing playback ON, while making calls.

The receiver’s tune, a shared experience.\n\nThe caller enjoys the receiver’s CallTune while the receiver hears their own CallTune. Hearing the receiver’s tune requires outgoing playback ON and their shared tune to be available.

A special tune for your favourite people.\n\nLet callers enjoy your shared CallTune while you recognise your favourite callers by the personal tunes you assign to them. Without an assignment, you hear your own usual tune. Hearing the receiver’s shared tune requires outgoing playback ON and their shared tune to be available.
When I call: play my own tune (ON). Tap to switch
When I call: play my own tune (OFF). Tap to switch
When I call: play the receiver’s tune (ON). Tap to switch
When I call: play the receiver’s tune (OFF). Tap to switch
